title: UpsertRelationship
description: A typed edge between two existing entities — GLEIF parent-of, lobbyist-represents-company, contract-located-in-NUTS, etc. The producer specifies the predicate as a fontem ontology IRI (or shorthand) and the two endpoint IRIs; sinks materialise the edge as a Neo4j relationship and an RDF triple. Properties on the edge are an open `properties` bag — keep them sparse, since heavy attribute-on-edge usage is a smell that should be modelled as its own entity instead.

predicate.description: Either a full IRI or a shorthand registered in the sink's predicate map (e.g. 'parentOf', 'represents', 'locatedIn').

properties.description: Optional edge properties. Sparse by convention.
